name: Momir Vig
description: Simic guildmaster who sends Capobar and is killed.

description_citations.text: "The Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Ravnica the Guildpact is broken and the Dissension unfolds.
timeline.quote: The subsequent breaking of the Guildpact and the events of the Dissension

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Events on Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig, dissatisfied with the guild, forms a new purpose of improving Ravnica's life forms and creates cytoplasts.
timeline.quote: formed a new purpose: to improve upon the life forms of Ravnica

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vig creates a cytoplast that bonds without consent, since Ravnicans refused to be improved.
timeline.quote: This allowed Vig to improve the people of Ravnica without needing their consent.

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vig allies with Svogthir to activate Project Kraj and is killed by Agrus Kos.
timeline.quote: He was consequently killed by Agrus Kos .

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig proposes pitting Razia and the Azorius sky marshals in a bidding war to fund Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: We could create a fine bidding war—enough to fund the final stages of Project Kraj.

citation.text: Assault Zeppelid (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig says Experiment Kraj was designed to choose its own evolution.
timeline.quote: it was designed to choose its own evolution.

citation.text: Experiment Kraj (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Evern's partners sold dragon fluid to Lyzolda; they meet contractor Momir Vig and partners Szadek and Savra.
timeline.quote: they sold some of the dragon's liquid to Lyzolda , the acting Guildmaster of the Rakdos.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 6". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Evern warns Kos and Augustin that Momir Vig and the Simic work with the God-Zombie Svogthir in Savra's body.
timeline.quote: Evern Capobar shows up to warn them about Momir Vig and the Simic, who are working together with the God-Zombie Svogthir who was inhabiting the body of Savra.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 10". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig explains that the dragon's fluid was needed to complete Experiment Kraj.
timeline.quote: explains how the dragon's cerebral fluid was needed to complete the Experiment Kraj .

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 14". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kos transfers into Savra's corpse, overpowering Svogthir, and kills Momir Vig before he can control Kraj.
timeline.quote: but then Kos kills Vig before he can take control of Kraj completely.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 16". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos kills Momir Vig, Kraj falls, Rakdos is badly damaged and Izolda is torn apart by her cultists; Rakdos falls into a coma.
timeline.quote: However, Vig was killed by Agrus Kos and Kraj fell later, during the fight.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Szadek murders Savra, Svogthir's spirit takes over her corpse and allies with Momir Vig to use Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: Svogthir's spirit took over the treacherous elf 's corpse

citation.text: "Svogthir", section "Last sighting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos overpowers Svogthir's mind and kills Vig, then Kraj destroys Vig's lab with Svogthir inside; his fate is unknown.
timeline.quote: His fate after this is unknown

citation.text: "Svogthir", section "Last sighting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Capobar retrieves cerebral fluid in Utvara and finds the nephilim feeding on the dragon and growing titanic.
timeline.quote: had been feeding upon the dragon, and were steadily growing to titanic size.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The remaining nephilim are stopped by Fonn's Ledev team and Rakdos; Rakdos and Kraj fight to a draw and both are incapacitated; Rakdos returns to his lava pit and Svogthir and Momir Vig are killed.
timeline.quote: both titans ended up incapacitated.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zegana condemns Momir Vig's hubris and says the merfolk have sought out what remains of the Combine.
timeline.quote: We have sought out what is left of the Combine.

citation.text: "The Fathom Edict". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Raiche reports to Momir Vig that ZV29K is now a mindless cytoplastic life form held with the others, and that the human trials are nearly complete.
timeline.quote: The resulting cytoplastic life form is now kept in the Eastern Holding Facility with the others

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "Official Communication, 17 Mokosh 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The group presents the recovered Simic artifacts, including the lost keyrune of Momir Vig, to the zonot's guardians and tours a museum.
timeline.quote: the lost keyrune of Momir Vig

citation.text: "Medge", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The class brings the Simic artifacts to the guardians, who recognize Momir Vig's stolen keyrune, and the museum puts it on display.
timeline.quote: this is Momir Vig's keyrune. Stolen nearly a century ago.

citation.text: "The Principles of Unnatural Selection" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Kos possesses a Virusoid guard to enter Novijen and kills Momir Vig, too late to stop Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: Kos was left with little choice and killed the mad genius

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Kos kills Momir Vig, the senate votes to place Ravnica under martial law under Augustin.
timeline.quote: they voted to place Ravnica under martial law under his guidance

citation.text: "Augustin IV", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Izolda tries to raise and control Rakdos using draconic cerebral fluid from Momir Vig and Myc's blood; Myc's parents unintentionally disrupt the spell, joining Myc's and Rakdos's minds.
timeline.quote: resulted in a shared mind between Myc and Rakdos instead

citation.text: "Izolda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vig is killed by Agrus Kos and Rakdos is trapped within Kraj, suffering extensive damage.
timeline.quote: Vig was killed by Agrus Kos

citation.text: "Izolda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig becomes guildmaster of the Simic Combine and seeks to enhance life through experimentation.
timeline.quote: Momir Vig became the guildmaster of the Simic Combine in Cizarm of 9211 ZC.

citation.text: "Momir Vig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vig develops cytoplasts to store and transfer beneficial traits.
timeline.quote: he developed cytoplasts

citation.text: "Momir Vig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vig engineers a cytoplast that bonds by contact, bypassing consent.
timeline.quote: Vig engineered a new variant of cytoplast that could bond with a host through simple contact

citation.text: "Momir Vig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vig allies with Svogthir and they initiate Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: Vig eventually allied with Svogthir

citation.text: "Momir Vig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos kills Vig by stabbing him in the eye.
timeline.quote: slew Vig by stabbing him in the eye

citation.text: "Momir Vig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As Prime Speaker, Zegana delivers the Fathom Edict declaring a new beginning after Momir Vig's fall.
timeline.quote: Zegana delivered the Fathom Edict

citation.text: "Zegana", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: They condemn his hubris and the havoc of his creations.
relations.quote: the havoc wreaked by his creations is not forgivable.

citation.text: "The Fathom Edict". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

citation.text: "Izolda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: TO: Momir Vig REGARDING: Cytoplast Revitalization Project

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "Official Communication, 17 Mokosh 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Vig was killed by Agrus Kos during the events of Ravnica block .

citation.text: "Momir Vig". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: They allied to wipe Ravnica clean.
relations.quote: He made an alliance with the Simic guildmaster Momir Vig
